headline: Anthropic raises $81 billion in record IPO
deck: The AI company priced its public offering at $83 a share, Reuters reports.
caption:
AI FINANCE | Anthropic has raised approximately $81.31 billion in a record-setting IPO, pricing 980 million shares at $83 each, according to Reuters.

Source: Reuters, November 18–19, 2026.
